engine: QuickJS-NG v0.18.0; native C, statically linked

contract.execution: Script body runs in an async IIFE within a persistent globalThis realm. Per-agent runtimes are isolated. One active call per agent. Native QtCore worker subprocess; no Node or browser page JS application shell.
contract.result: JSON object with message and result; result joins API.output values followed by a non-null/undefined return value. Strings remain strings; other values use JSON serialization. Console is diagnostic and excluded from model tool output.
contract.errors: completed(id, output, true), with structured message/error and partial output. Ordinary JS errors preserve globals; cancellation, deadline and native allocation exhaustion reset the affected context.
contract.CDP: API.sendCDP(tabId,method,params) returns a promise resolved with parsed raw protocol JSON or rejected with broker error. Correlated UUIDs prevent late replies from settling reused external IDs.
contract.files: fsPromises.readFile/writeFile, fs.promises, callback fs.readFile/writeFile and require('fs'/'fs/promises') use native parent ToolExecutor. ws1/ and w1/ aliases map to the configured workspace. No direct JS OS access; ToolExecutor canonicalizes and rejects outside paths, binary/invalid UTF8 reads, and truncation. Text and BOM/newline bytes are preserved. Unsupported encodings/options/operations reject explicitly.
contract.attachments: API.createAttachment(originalFileName, Buffer or base64 string) stores a bounded file with safe unique name in the configured native artifact directory, signals the actual path/mime, and returns canonical filename, matching upstream return shape. Parent attachment notification precedes tool result completion; link/junction artifact roots reject. Idle behavior audit: audit/sandbox-idle-attachments.json.
contract.broker_lifetime: Script-body requests must be awaited; its unfinished broker requests are canceled when the originating call finishes. Persistent CDP/app subscriptions and independent idle event/timer requests survive with host-issued generation checks, bounded event queues and a 45-second broker deadline. See audit/mini-apps-native.json.
contract.network: Buffered HTTP(S) fetch, Headers, Request, Response and AbortController/Signal are implemented through the parent NetworkBroker. Text/binary bodies, text/json/arrayBuffer/bytes consumption, clone/bodyUsed, HTTP errors, redirects and per-request cancellation are covered by loopback tests. Full Web API parity is not claimed. See audit/sandbox-network.json.
contract.credentials: API.getCredential returns host-authorized opaque placeholder fields or null. Real credential values stay in the parent broker; host-derived execution agent IDs gate lookup and substitution. Context reset signals invalidate handles after cancellation, deadline/memory reset, idle realm failure, explicit reset or worker exit.
contract.mini_apps: API.openApp/closeApp/sendMessage/onMessage and persistent API.onCDPEvent are implemented through native hosts, with per-agent origin/profile/tab ownership checks. Supplied Figma recipe passes a controlled local end-to-end fixture; no real Figma service validation. See audit/mini-apps-native.json.

bounds.memory_mechanism: Custom QuickJS allocator tracks actual engine allocation bytes and retains exhaustion state even when allocating an Error fails. Stack limit 1 MiB. Native buffers/frame/result sizes independently bounded.
bounds.cancel: Reader thread sets an atomic cancellation flag while JS runs; the QuickJS interrupt hook exits synchronous loops. Parent watchdog kills an unresponsive native worker.

privacy_boundary: The worker receives a whitelisted OS environment, not provider API keys, tokens or proxy secrets. Page calls receive only explicitly supplied CDP parameters. Network/credential operations are parent-broker IPC; no direct worker sockets or unrestricted quickjs-libc OS modules are linked. The parent substitutes only host-authorized opaque credentials at allowed destinations and rejects known secret reflection. This is application-level isolation, not an OS security sandbox guarantee.

verification.result: 22 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (including init/cleanup), after persistent events and attachment regressions.
verification.full_native_runtime_integration: tests/test_runtime.cpp passed through CTest native_runtime in 4.83s (four cases plus init/cleanup). Real local HTTP provider SSE drives AgentEngine and AgentToolHost through the native worker into real WebView2/CDP, UTF8 files and screenshot attachment; separate cases cover CDP failure/model continuation, shared-browser host isolation/cancellation, and host teardown while CDP is pending. Log: test-results/runtime-tests.txt.

persistent async globals and isolated agents

concrete_fixes: QuickJS memory exhaustion could reject with null, obscuring the failure and retaining an exhausted context; bounded allocator now classifies and resets it.
Interrupted async continuations could lose their synchronous-deadline reason after the native call returned; sticky interruption classification preserves reason and resets context.
QString::fromUtf8 removed initial BOM at JS/native string boundaries; explicit stateless decoding now preserves BOM. Regression compares actual EFBBBF bytes.
Streaming UTF8 decoders could buffer incomplete trailing sequences without immediate error; whole-buffer validation uses Stateless and rejects data loss.
Direct host deletion from callbacks could leave exit/watchdog handlers accessing a destroyed instance; signal boundaries now guard lifetime and tests delete immediately.
Empty API.output/console messages could evade a character-only bound; independent message-count bounds stop unbounded streams.
Canceling a tool now synchronously invalidates its context and stops outstanding native broker requests; waiting for worker cancel acknowledgment previously left a real fetch running briefly.
Context generation UUIDs and bounded event queues prevent late callbacks from reaching replacement agents and stop unbounded idle event backlogs.
Attachment artifact roots reject existing links/junctions, and notifications occur before RPC result delivery.
Attachments created by persistent callbacks are attributed to an active same-agent/context tool when one exists; true idle writes remain successful without attaching to a later or foreign-agent tool.
remaining_upstream_gaps: Complete Node builtin compatibility (crypto/events/path/querystring/stream/string_decoder/url/util/zlib/assert); Buffer and text helper APIs are a documented subset.

Full Web API compatibility including URL/URLSearchParams, Blob, FormData, readable/writable streams and streaming response bodies; current fetch is bounded and buffered. Browser cookies and non-omit request credentials are explicitly unsupported.
General mounted filesystem APIs, multiple mounts, permission matrix and attachment/log/shell mounts; current file helper scope is workspace UTF8 read/write.
Output overflow is an explicit error rather than upstream capToolOutput truncation. Cancellation/deadline resets state deliberately; exact upstream post-timeout persistence is not claimed.
Script-body unawaited broker promises are canceled on return; independent idle listeners/background requests persist. Full async-local event continuation ownership is not claimed.
Mini-app writable apps/ mount and arbitrary remote-resource HTML support remain incomplete; see audit/mini-apps-native.json.
